005package armyc2.c2sd.graphics2d;
006/**
007 *
008 * @author Michael Deutch
009 */
010public class Rectangle implements Shape{
011    public int x=0;
012    public int y=0;
013    public int width=0;
014    public int height=0;
015    public Rectangle()
016    {
017        x=0;
018        y=0;
019        width=0;
020        height=0;
021    }
022    public Rectangle(int x1, int y1, int width1, int height1)
023    {
024        x=x1;
025        y=y1;
026        width=width1;
027        height=height1;
028    }
029    public Rectangle getBounds()
030    {
031        return this;
032    }
033    public PathIterator getPathIterator(AffineTransform at)
034    {
035        return null;
036    }
037    public boolean intersects(Rectangle2D rect)
038    {
039        if(x+width<rect.x)
040            return false;
041        if(x>rect.x+rect.width)
042            return false;
043        if(y+height<rect.y)
044            return false;
045        if(y>rect.y+rect.height)
046            return false;
047        
048        return true;
049    }
050    public boolean intersects(double x1, double y1, double width1, double height1)
051    {
052        if(x+width<x1)
053            return false;
054        if(x>x1+width1)
055            return false;
056        if(y+height<y1)
057            return false;
058        if(y>y1+height1)
059            return false;
060        
061        return true;
062    }
063    public boolean contains (int x1, int y1)
064    {
065        if(x<=x1 && x1<=x+width  && 
066                y<=y1 && y1<=y+height)
067            return true;
068        else return false;
069    }
070    public boolean contains (int x1, int y1, int width1, int height1)
071    {                             
072        if(this.contains(x1, y1) && this.contains(x1+width1, y1+height1))
073            return true;
074        else return false;
075    }
076    public boolean contains (Point2D pt)
077    {
078        if(x<=pt.getX() && pt.getX()<=x+width  && 
079                y<=pt.getY() && pt.getY()<=y+height)
080            return true;
081        else return false;
082    }
083    public Rectangle2D getBounds2D()
084    {
085        return new Rectangle2D.Double(x,y,width,height);
086    }
087     public double getX()
088    {
089        return x;
090    }
091    public int getY()
092    {
093        return y;
094    }
095    public int getMinX()
096    {
097        return x;
098    }
099    public int getMinY()
100    {
101        return y;
102    }
103    public int getMaxX()
104    {
105        return x+width;
106    }
107    public int getMaxY()
108    {
109        return y+height;
110    }
111    public int getHeight()
112    {
113        return height;
114    }
115    public int getWidth()
116    {
117        return width;
118    }
119    //must complete this function
120    public void grow(int h, int v)  
121    {
122        //return;
123    }
124    public void setRect(Rectangle rect)
125    {
126        x=rect.x;
127        y=rect.y;
128        width=rect.width;
129        height=rect.height;
130    }
131}
